text:
zoe.marketing: quick alert from this morning's webinar follow-up  about 2% of HubSpot leads aren't landing in RR when enrichment takes longer than our handshake window. SDRs are doing extra manual claims.
jamal.ops: thanks. do we have traces? is the router timing out and moving to Backfill or Failover? :mag: 
zoe.marketing: pasted one trace in #alerts but short repro: HS webhook accepted -> external enrich takes 9-15s -> router TTL=5s -> router pushes to FallbackQueue. claim workers only poll RR, so leads sit ~20-40m until backfill.
mike.salesops: can we introduce a small "grace-window" path so leads are held briefly for enrichment instead of falling back immediately? SDR inbox must remain clean.
jamal.ops: two options: 1) HubSpot workflow marks leads with `grace_hold=true` and routes to GatewayQueue that router checks, or 2) router does a quick enrich-probe on receipt and extends TTL when enrich is in-progress. Probe avoids workflow churn.
olivia.eng: engineering note: probe is the least invasive. I'll implement an opt-in router probe: on webhook receipt do GET /enrich/status/{lead_id} with 150ms timeout. If 200 && done -> route immediately. If 202 + header `X-Enrich-ETA-ms` -> extend handshake TTL by min(ETA,25000). Otherwise follow current path. Add feature-flag `grace_probe_v1`.
yusuf.sdr: from SDR ops perspective, we must not surface probed leads in inbox. please auto-set owner=unassigned and add `grace_flag=true` so we can filter. Also digest for items >10m.
mike.salesops: we'll update HS campaign workflow to include owner=unassigned and optionally `grace_hold=true` for experiments. Enrichment webhook should set `enrich_state=done` and call `/router/replay`. I'll draft the workflow snippet for sandbox testing.
jamal.ops: metrics: add gauge grace_probe_calls, counter grace_probe_extended, histogram grace_probe_extension_ms, and alert if extension_rate > 1% of daily leads or if manual_claims/hour increases by >15%.
olivia.eng: I'll open small PR with probe + metrics today and target a canary deploy tomorrow 10:00 PT behind `grace_probe_v1`. Also adding a fallback GatewayQueue implementation as Plan B if probe causes issues.
zoe.marketing: timeline is tight  want before next campaign on Friday. canary tomorrow works. mike, can you coordinate HS sandbox?
mike.salesops: yes. will update sandbox workflows and post testing steps in #marketing. also propose a temporary column in SDR UI to hide `grace_flag=true` leads.
yusuf.sdr: perfect. please also add a 15-min digest for any leads that remain unassigned after 15m so we can triage degraded flow.
jamal.ops: post-canary runbook: monitor percent held, percent recovered to RR, manual_claim delta, backfill volume. rollback if manual_claims spike or >0.5% leads are held >60s.
lead-router-bot: deploy scheduled: grace-probe-v1 by olivia.eng  canary queued. :rocket: 
olivia.eng: PR opened (#4821). probe implementation summary: 1) probe enrich svc on receipt; 2) extend TTL by min(ETA,25s) on 202 with ETA; 3) set router label `route=grace_probe`; 4) emit metrics. Will include feature flag and rollback toggle.
zoe.marketing: thanks team  add playbook note: "Grace-probe may delay assignment up to 25s; SDRs should not claim unless enrich_state=done or lead >15m in unassigned state." I'll coordinate post-canary review with SDR leads. :white_check_mark:
